known_pitfall_claim: The proof claims that Re ∘ f and Im ∘ f are functions from R to R, although f is defined only on [a,b], so the composites have domain [a,b].
pitfall_counterexample: Let a=0, b=1, and f:[0,1]→ℂ be f(x)=x+ix. It is continuous. For x∈[0,1], (Re∘f)(x)=x and (Im∘f)(x)=x. At the real input x=2, f(2) is undefined because 2∉[0,1].
